title: Process Burst IDs
description: Asked after the burst-ID (.bst) files were written: what to do with them.

sections.text: Choose what to do with the saved Burst IDs:

sections.label: Compute microtime histogram
sections.description: Compute a microtime (decay) histogram for the selected bursts.

sections.label: Open FCS Correlator Wizard to correlate BST files
sections.description: Open the FCS correlator wizard afterwards to correlate the burst photon files.

buttons.label: OK
buttons.description: Accept the entries and close the dialog.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Discard the changes and close the dialog.
